name: Kasasagi ga Naku, Kimi o Aogu
original_name: かささぎが鳴く、君を仰ぐ
source:
In the gray room, two men are sitting in a black chair and talking. Sayu and Kasasagi.
Kasasagi seems to have been imprisoned by Sayu for another month.

The relationship between the two is revealed little by little. Unfocused hope.

… A distorted shadow is approaching.


[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/27745]Freem[/url]]
translation:
灰色的房间里，两个男人坐在黑色的椅子上聊天。纱由和笠鹭。
笠鹭似乎又被沙优囚禁了一个月。

两人的关系一点点被揭开。没有聚焦的希望。

……一道扭曲的影子正在逼近。
